sentences.en: They're called detainers.

sentences.en: And they ask sheriffs to hold people for 48 hours after their criminal release dates to give ICE enough time, practically speaking, to come and pick them up.

sentences.en: But here's the problem.
sentences.zh: 但问题就在这里。

sentences.en: As soon as someone posts bail or as soon as their criminal sentence is complete, under the Constitution, they have to be released.
sentences.zh: 根据宪法，一旦某人缴纳了保释金，或者一旦他们的刑事刑期结束，他们就必须被释放。

sentences.en: And numerous courts, including federal circuit courts, have found that holding somebody in custody for any additional period of time constitutes an unlawful seizure.

sentences.en: So the Trump administration is asking local police departments to essentially violate the

sentences.en: Constitution when they ask them to hold these criminal, undocumented immigrants longer than their sentences.
sentences.zh: 宪法，当他们要求他们扣留这些刑事无证移民超过他们的刑期时。

sentences.en: That's exactly what's happening.

sentences.en: So this is a longstanding issue.

sentences.en: And it was a problem and a source of friction between federal and local authorities under the Obama administration as well.
sentences.zh: 在奥巴马政府时期，这也是联邦和地方当局之间摩擦的根源和问题所在。

sentences.en: But under President
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普总统

sentences.en: So they issue roughly 12,000 every month.
sentences.zh: 所以他们每月大约发出12,000份请求。

sentences.en: And we don't have an exact number for how many are ignored.

sentences.en: But hundreds of sheriff's departments across the country have policies where these detainers come in and they just get ignored.

sentences.en: There's a case in Miami-Dade right now where, in direct response to Jeff Sessions' public statements and condemnations of places that don't
sentences.zh: 迈阿密-戴德县现在就有一个案件，为了直接回应杰夫·塞申斯对那些不履行

sentences.en: honor detainers, local officials made an announcement.
sentences.zh: 拘留请求的地方的公开声明和谴责，当地官员发表了一项声明。

sentences.en: They said, we're going to play ball with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们将与特朗普政府合作。

sentences.en: We're going to help with deportations.
sentences.zh: 我们将协助驱逐出境。

sentences.en: They were promptly sued.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就被起诉了。

sentences.en: They actually held somebody on an ICE detainer who turned out to be an American citizen.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上根据ICE的拘留请求扣留了一个人，结果发现那个人是美国公民。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That case is being litigated now.
sentences.zh: 该案目前正在诉讼中。

sentences.en: And the Sessions Justice Department has filed briefs, has asked to present oral arguments, is really trying to go to bat on behalf of this county, and has held it up as an example.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯领导的司法部已经提交了简报，要求进行口头辩论，确实在努力代表该县进行辩护，并将其作为一个典型案例。

sentences.en: But it, like many others, is now caught up in litigation.
sentences.zh: 但它和许多其他案件一样，现在陷入了诉讼之中。

sentences.en: And it's going to be costly.
sentences.zh: 而且这会付出高昂的代价。

sentences.en: So these communities have an incredibly difficult choice to make right now.
sentences.zh: 所以这些社区现在面临着一个极其艰难的选择。

sentences.en: It's an impossible bind, if you think about it.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，这真是一个进退两难的困境。

sentences.en: It's violate the Constitution, potentially face very expensive lawsuits, as many sheriffs have as a result, or put serial
sentences.zh: 要么违反宪法，可能面临代价高昂的诉讼——正如许多警长因此而遭遇的那样，要么把惯犯

sentences.en: criminals back out on the streets and cross the Trump administration and face its wrath.
sentences.zh: 放回街头，从而得罪特朗普政府并招致其愤怒。

sentences.en: No, I didn't release them.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有释放他们。

sentences.en: I held on to them, took the chance.
sentences.zh: 我留住了他们，冒了这个险。

sentences.en: I don't want to see somebody get hurt or killed because of what one of these criminally illegals did.
sentences.zh: 我不希望看到有人因为这些非法移民罪犯的行为而受伤或丧命。

sentences.en: And I made a decision that the scales tilted the other way.
sentences.zh: 我做出了决定，天平向另一边倾斜了。

sentences.en: And if somebody sued us, then they sued us.
sentences.zh: 如果有人起诉我们，那就起诉吧。

sentences.en: And if I had to pay, I would have paid.
sentences.zh: 如果我必须赔偿，我会赔偿的。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I don't want to put somebody on the street and have them do harm to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我也不想把人放回街头，让他们去伤害别人。

sentences.en: You know, I'm the sheriff, but I'm also a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是警长，但我也是一名律师。

sentences.en: I would call it the
sentences.zh: 我会称之为

sentences.en: ultimate dilemma, if you will.
sentences.zh: 终极困境，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: There's very few decisions that are as hard as that, because you know that you're violating civil rights laws.
sentences.zh: 很少有决定像这样艰难，因为你知道你正在违反民权法。

sentences.en: There's no question about it.
sentences.zh: 这一点毫无疑问。

sentences.en: And at the same time, our job is to affect public safety and make sure that nobody gets hurt.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们的工作是维护公共安全，确保没有人受到伤害。

sentences.en: So you're in this
sentences.zh: 所以你陷入了这种

sentences.en: quagmire, rock and a hard place where, you know, which side of the job, which side of what your
sentences.zh: 泥潭，进退维谷，你知道，工作的哪一面，你职责的哪一面，

sentences.en: obligation is, which side of your oath is that, which side, which side are you going to compromise here?
sentences.zh: 誓言的哪一面，哪一面，你打算在这里妥协哪一面？

sentences.en: Which is the worst of the two evils of violating somebody's rights and violating the law, which you're clearly doing, or put somebody on the street and they go kill someone.
sentences.zh: 两害相权取其轻，是违反某人的权利和法律——这显然是你正在做的，还是把人放回街头，然后他们去杀了人。

sentences.en: He didn't feel good about it.
sentences.zh: 他对此感到不安。

sentences.en: He didn't feel like he was protecting his community as he was charged to do.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他没有像被要求的那样保护好他的社区。

sentences.en: So he started working really late nights.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始熬夜工作。

sentences.en: He started working on weekends, poring over legal textbooks, looking at court precedent, trying to find a solution.
sentences.zh: 他开始在周末工作，钻研法律教科书，查阅法院判例，试图寻找解决方案。

sentences.en: And eventually he thinks he came up with one and he honors detainers.
sentences.zh: 最终他认为他想出了一个办法，那就是尊重拘留请求。

sentences.en: He hasn't been challenged in court yet.
sentences.zh: 他还没有在法庭上受到挑战。

sentences.en: It's a very complicated solution.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's a workaround, but it's under a contract that we have with the United States Marshal Service.
sentences.zh: 这是一种变通方法，但它是在我们与美国法警局签订的合同框架下进行的。

sentences.en: We house federal inmates.
sentences.zh: 我们收容联邦囚犯。

sentences.en: And we were able to come up with a way that we were able to hold these people, not using the detainer, but using the contract that we have to house these federal inmates.
sentences.zh: 我们想出了一种方法，让我们能够扣留这些人，不是使用拘留请求，而是利用我们收容这些联邦囚犯的合同。

sentences.en: So we were housing them for ICE, but we weren't in a situation where we were executing the warrant.
sentences.zh: 所以我们是在为移民及海关执法局（ICE）收容他们，但我们并没有处于执行逮捕令的境地。

sentences.en: And since we had that in place, we were one of the few agencies in the country.
sentences.zh: 由于我们落实了这一点，我们成为了全国为数不多的机构之一。

sentences.en: You've got about 3,100 sheriff's offices in the country, 3,100 basically county jails.
sentences.zh: 全国大约有3100个警长办公室，基本上就是3100个县监狱。

sentences.en: And we were only one of a few that had that in place.
sentences.zh: 我们是少数几个落实了这一点的机构之一。

sentences.en: So we were able to come up with this workaround.
sentences.zh: 所以我们能够想出这种变通办法。

sentences.en: My legal opinion of this isn't solid.
sentences.zh: 我对这一点的法律意见并不稳固。

sentences.en: So we've been working hard with ICE and the
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直在与ICE和

sentences.en: Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Justice to try and get this implemented universally.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部以及司法部努力合作，试图在全国范围内实施这一方案。

sentences.en: I've been in Washington a few times, several times actually, and had meetings and discussions.
sentences.zh: 我去过华盛顿几次，实际上是好几次，进行了会议和讨论。

sentences.en: It's actively ongoing right now, trying to, what I hope is put the finishing touches on it so we can roll it out nationwide.
sentences.zh: 目前这项工作正在积极进行中，我希望能够完成最后的润色，以便我们在全国范围内推广。

sentences.en: How is it possible, given how long we have been dealing as a country with undocumented immigrants coming over the borders and committing crimes, that there remains this
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们国家处理非法移民越境犯罪问题已经这么久了，怎么可能仍然存在这种

sentences.en: legal conflict and kind of gulf between the federal needs for deportation and the local prosecution and detention of criminals?
sentences.zh: 法律冲突，以及联邦驱逐需求与地方起诉和拘留罪犯之间的鸿沟？

sentences.en: So it's a little complicated, so stick with me for a minute.
sentences.zh: 这有点复杂，所以请听我慢慢道来。

sentences.en: But at the heart of it is that immigration law is civil law.
sentences.zh: 但其核心在于移民法是民法。

sentences.en: Being in the country illegally is a violation of civil code.
sentences.zh: 非法居留是违反民法典的行为。

sentences.en: And sheriffs are enforcers of criminal law.
sentences.zh: 而警长是刑法的执行者。

sentences.en: They don't have any power to enforce civil law.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何权力执行民法。

sentences.en: So an immigration officer doesn't have the power to go out and ask a judge for a warrant to hold someone in custody for being in the United States illegally.
sentences.zh: 所以移民官员没有权力去向法官申请逮捕令，以非法居留为由将某人拘留。

sentences.en: All they have is this detainer.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有的只有这种拘留请求。

sentences.en: And a sheriff can't do anything with a detainer.
sentences.zh: 而警长对拘留请求无能为力。

sentences.en: They need a warrant.
sentences.zh: 他们需要逮捕令。

sentences.en: That's the document that legally allows them to hold somebody in custody.
sentences.zh: 那是法律上允许他们拘留某人的文件。

sentences.en: So these two different law enforcement entities are speaking different languages.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个不同的执法实体在说不同的语言。

sentences.en: They don't work well together.
sentences.zh: 他们配合得并不好。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration wants sheriffs to sort of bulldoze through that disconnect.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府希望警长们能以某种方式强行解决这种脱节。

sentences.en: But the sheriffs are saying, wait, I can't do that.
sentences.zh: 但警长们说，等等，我做不到。

sentences.en: The law doesn't allow it.
sentences.zh: 法律不允许这样做。

sentences.en: Why isn't it a criminal violation to cross the border?
sentences.zh: 为什么越境不是刑事犯罪？

sentences.en: To my mind, it always has been, but I didn't know it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，它一直都是，但我不知道它不是。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有趣。

sentences.en: It's definitely a recent change I think you're picking up on in the way that the general public thinks about immigration violations.
sentences.zh: 我认为你所察觉到的公众对移民违规行为看法的转变，绝对是最近才发生的。

sentences.en: And that's in large part due to political shifts.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上归因于政治转变。

sentences.en: We've got an administration who right now, I think you can safely say is the least sympathetic to people who have entered the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的政府，我想你可以肯定地说，是对非法入境者最缺乏同情心的政府。

sentences.en: But throughout the country's history, I mean, the short answer to your question is just that being here without legal status
sentences.zh: 但在整个国家历史上，我的意思是，你问题的简短回答就是，没有合法身份待在这里

sentences.en: wasn't a big deal, wasn't as big a deal to rise to the level of being considered worthy of a criminal violation.
sentences.zh: 并不是什么大不了的事，没有严重到被认为值得定为刑事犯罪的程度。

sentences.en: And that's why it's always been codified legally as a civil violation, something where the stakes are a lot lower.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它在法律上一直被编纂为民事违规行为，风险要低得多。

sentences.en: So it's like American cultural and political expectations around illegal immigration have not been caught up to by the legal code is essentially what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，美国文化和政治对非法移民的期望还没有被法律条文所跟上。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: The legal code lags far behind the way that you hear the president and the attorney general talk about immigration violations today.
sentences.zh: 法律条文远远落后于今天你听到总统和司法部长谈论移民违规行为的方式。

sentences.en: Or the legal code is exactly where many people think it should be.
sentences.zh: 或者说，法律条文正是许多人认为它应该有的样子。

sentences.en: Both are true, which is why this is such a tricky topic because we're so divided as a country.
sentences.zh: 两者都是事实，这就是为什么这是一个如此棘手的话题，因为我们国家分歧如此严重。

sentences.en: And has anyone ever tried to fix this disconnect to basically get these two branches of the
sentences.zh: 有没有人尝试过解决这种脱节，基本上让这两个政府部门，

sentences.en: government, the local sheriffs and the federal immigration officials to be speaking the same language?
sentences.zh: 地方警长和联邦移民官员说同一种语言？

sentences.en: And how is it possible that they're not still?
sentences.zh: 为什么现在还没解决？

sentences.en: The only way to truly allow these two groups to speak the same language is to retool the federal
sentences.zh: 真正让这两组人说同一种语言的唯一方法是重组联邦

sentences.en: immigration law and make it a criminal violation to be in the United States illegally.
sentences.zh: 移民法，并将非法居留美国定为刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: Congress could do that.
sentences.zh: 国会可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: And the absence of that kind of major change, the Trump administration has made small gestures to try to make detainer requests more legally viable to give them more might.
sentences.zh: 在缺乏这种重大变革的情况下，特朗普政府采取了一些小动作，试图使拘留请求在法律上更可行，赋予它们更大的效力。

sentences.en: For example, they retooled the document and removed the word voluntary, hoping that that might compel sheriffs to comply.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们修改了文件并删除了“自愿”一词，希望这能迫使警长们遵守。

sentences.en: But sheriffs say, we're still facing the same dilemma.
sentences.zh: 但警长们说，我们仍然面临同样的困境。

sentences.en: You can use whatever language you want, but unless you change the law, we're really stuck.
sentences.zh: 你可以使用任何你想要的措辞，但除非你修改法律，否则我们真的被困住了。

sentences.en: 31-year-old Sergio Martinez appeared in a special jail spot for arraignment today.
sentences.zh: 31岁的塞尔吉奥·马丁内斯今天出现在一个特殊的监狱地点接受传讯。

sentences.en: He's been in the
sentences.zh: 他之前曾被关在

sentences.en: Multnomah County Jail before and once alluded to suicide attempts, according to court documents.
sentences.zh: 马尔特诺马县监狱，据法庭文件显示，他曾暗示过自杀企图。

sentences.en: He's charged with sex abuse, sodomy, burglary, robbery, assault, and kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 他被控性虐待、鸡奸、入室盗窃、抢劫、袭击和绑架。

sentences.en: That brings us back to Sergio Martinez, who was let out because of this conflict in the law and then committed those two crimes.
sentences.zh: 这让我们回到塞尔吉奥·马丁内斯，他因为法律上的这种冲突而被释放，然后犯下了那两起罪行。

sentences.en: What does the sheriff in Portland say about this?
sentences.zh: 波特兰的警长对此怎么说？

sentences.en: And I wonder how much anguish this case presents for him.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这个案件给他带来了多少痛苦。

sentences.en: This, as far as I can tell, was a really difficult case locally.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这在当地是一个非常棘手的案件。

sentences.en: It's a part of the country where people are very sympathetic to the cause of undocumented immigrants, and yet the case is so brutal that
sentences.zh: 在这个国家的这个地区，人们非常同情非法移民的事业，然而这个案件如此残忍，以至于

sentences.en: I think the entire community was sort of tied up in knots.
sentences.zh: 我认为整个社区都陷入了纠结之中。

sentences.en: So the sheriff in Portland, Mike Reese, said that he felt stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以波特兰的警长迈克·里斯说他感到进退两难。

sentences.en: He said that he did everything that he could under the law.
sentences.zh: 他说他在法律允许的范围内尽了一切努力。

sentences.en: He wished it didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 他希望这件事没有发生。

sentences.en: He wished that he could have turned Sergio Martinez over to ICE, but he just couldn't.
sentences.zh: 他希望他能把塞尔吉奥·马丁内斯移交给ICE，但他实在做不到。

sentences.en: I, Michael Reese, do solemnly swear that I will support the Constitution of the United States,
sentences.zh: 我，迈克尔·里斯，庄严宣誓，我将支持美利坚合众国宪法，

sentences.en: the Constitution of the State of Oregon, and the laws thereof, the charter of the county of Multnomah.
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州宪法及其法律，以及马尔特诺马县宪章。

sentences.en: This question is so vexing that legal analysts have described it as the biggest legal challenge
sentences.zh: 这个问题非常令人困扰，法律分析人士将其描述为特朗普政府面临的

sentences.en: confronting the Trump administration and its immigration agenda, which, as you know, is what the president was elected on.
sentences.zh: 最大法律挑战，而正如你所知，这正是总统当选的纲领。

sentences.en: So until it's resolved, I think the federal government and local sheriffs just aren't going to see eye to eye.
sentences.zh: 所以除非问题得到解决，否则我认为联邦政府和地方警长们是不会达成共识的。

sentences.en: Of the county of Multnomah, according to the best of my ability, so help me God.
sentences.zh: 马尔特诺马县的宪章，尽我所能，上帝保佑我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于对设计的热爱以及围绕它的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店当DJ的时候，在黑胶唱片时代，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去工作，你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报应用程序，即可免费访问30天。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that President Trump's legal team is fighting over how much to cooperate with the special counsel looking into Russia's role in the
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，特朗普总统的法律团队正在就与调查俄罗斯在选举中角色的特别检察官合作程度问题上发生争执，

sentences.en: election, a debate that led to an angry confrontation last week between two of Trump's lawyers that could shape the course of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论导致特朗普的两名律师上周发生了激烈的对抗，这可能会影响调查的进程。

sentences.en: After a Times reporter heard one of the lawyers, Ty Cobb, discussing the investigation at a steakhouse, Trump's general counsel, Donald McGahn, erupted at him
sentences.zh: 在一名《时报》记者听到其中一名律师泰·科布在一家牛排馆讨论调查后，特朗普的总法律顾问唐纳德·麦克加恩对他大发雷霆，

sentences.en: in a sign of the growing tensions.
sentences.zh: 这显示了日益紧张的关系。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: The United Nations is not a friend of democracy.
sentences.zh: 联合国不是民主的朋友。

sentences.en: It's not a friend to freedom.
sentences.zh: 它不是自由的朋友。

sentences.en: It's not a friend even to the United States of America, where, as you know, it has its home.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不是美利坚合众国的朋友，尽管如你所知，它的总部就在这里。

sentences.en: President Trump will deliver his first speech to the United Nations this week, after a campaign in which he repeatedly mocked the organization as ineffective and incompetent,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统本周将在联合国发表他的首次演讲，此前他在竞选中一再嘲笑该组织效率低下且无能，

sentences.en: and challenged the value of international cooperation.
sentences.zh: 并质疑国际合作的价值。

sentences.en: This week, the president's going up to the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 本周，总统将前往联合国。

sentences.en: He's going to speak.

sentences.en: He has talked about an America First policy.
